situation: My friend Priya's Instagram has been posting stories all morning about making $8,000 with a crypto 'mentor' and tagging people to DM him. Priya would never post that, and her phone number is saved in my contacts.
reply: Priya, your Instagram has been posting stories this morning about making $8,000 with a crypto mentor and tagging people to message him. I'm pretty sure that's not you, so I haven't replied or clicked anything. If you can still log in, change the password and turn on two-step; if not, use Instagram's hacked-account help. Then warn your followers from another account so nobody sends money. Call me if you want a hand.
note: Warn the real person by text or a call to the saved number, never by DM to the hacked account, and report the posts to Instagram so they come down faster.

situation: 我爸最近总跟我说他在一个'理财群'里跟着'老师'炒股赚了不少，还说老师让他加大投入、别跟家里人说。我很担心，但他很好面子。我这周六回家。
reply: 爸，想跟你聊聊那个理财群的事，我保证不是来说教的。那个老师有没有让你往他给的账户里转钱，或者让你别告诉家里人？现在这种骗子都很专业，很多聪明人都被骗过。不管情况怎样，我们一起想办法，我周六回家陪你一起看看。
note: 目标是让他愿意跟你说实话。羞辱会让他把下一个骗局藏起来。如果他已经往对方账户转过钱，尽快陪他打银行卡背面的电话并报警。

situation: My neighbour Gary (retired, 70s) just told me he clicked a parcel delivery text link yesterday and paid a £1.99 redelivery fee with his card. Now he's worried. I'm home all afternoon.
reply: Don't be hard on yourself, Gary, these texts are built to look exactly like the real thing. Call the number on the back of your card right now and tell them what happened, so they can block it before anything else goes through. Then report the text as spam to your phone provider and delete it. I'm home all afternoon if you want me to sit with you while you call.
note: Act first, talk later. Calling the bank fast is what limits the damage; then report it to the police or the national fraud reporting service.

situation: I do the accounts at a small architecture firm. Got an email that looks like it's from our print supplier Linden Press saying they've changed banks and we should pay their $6,420 invoice to a new account by Thursday. The address looks right but it feels off. Our contact there is Marcus, whose details we have on file, and my direct line is 555 0148.
reply: Hi Marcus, we received an email today from what looks like your accounts address, asking us to pay the $6,420 invoice into a new bank account by Thursday. We're holding the payment until we've confirmed it with you by phone, so could you call me on 555 0148 today or tomorrow? If that email didn't come from you, your mailbox may be compromised and it's worth telling your IT people.
note: Send this to the contact details already on file, never to the reply address or number in the suspicious email. If Marcus confirms it's fake, report the email to your own IT or email provider as phishing.

situation: 我姑姑昨天接到一个电话，声音特别像我表弟，说在外地出了车祸要她马上转3万，还不让告诉别人。幸好她打了表弟本人电话。想在家族群里提醒长辈们，但不想让姑姑难堪。
reply: 各位长辈，提醒大家一件事：最近有骗子用AI模仿孩子的声音打电话，说出了车祸或者被派出所扣了，要马上转钱，还叮嘱别告诉家里人。咱们家这两天就接到过一次，好在及时识破了。以后不管声音多像，只要是要钱，先挂掉，再用自己手机里存的号码打回去确认，或者在群里问一声。这种骗局很专业，谁都可能碰上，拿不准就随时打给我。
note: 群里提醒只讲骗局的套路和核实办法，不点名是谁接到的；让长辈觉得遇到了可以说，而不是怕丢面子。如果谁已经转了钱，马上打银行卡背面的电话并报警。

situation: My mom (68) has been chatting for 3 months with a man on Facebook called Richard who says he's an engineer on an oil rig. Now he wants $2,500 from her for a 'customs fee' to ship his things. She gets defensive when I bring it up. I can go over on Saturday.
reply: Mom, I'm glad you've had someone to talk to, and I'm not trying to take that away. Before any money goes anywhere, can we do one thing together: search for his photos online and see whether they turn up under other names. If he is who he says, they won't. I can come over Saturday and we'll do it together.
note: Don't say 'scam' to someone emotionally invested; agree on one check she can do without contacting him, and do it with her. If she has already sent money, help her call her bank's number and report it to the police.

situation: Someone texted pretending to be WhatsApp support and I gave them my 6-digit code. Now I'm locked out and my account is messaging my contacts asking for money. I've reported it to WhatsApp. What do I post on Instagram and text to my family?
reply: My WhatsApp has been taken over, so any message from it asking for money, codes or favours is not me. Please don't send anything or reply to it. If you're not sure whether a message is really from me, call me on my usual number. I'm working on getting the account back and I'll post here when it's sorted.
note: Warn people on channels the scammer can't reach, say exactly what to ignore and give one way to verify. Skip the story of how it happened; nobody needs it to stay safe. Anyone who has already sent money should call their bank and the police.

situation: Soy Lucía Romero. Me ha llegado un WhatsApp de un número que no conozco diciendo que son de Recursos Humanos de Hogar Sur, la cadena de tiendas, y que me ofrecen trabajar desde casa dando 'me gusta' a vídeos por 350 euros al día. Me piden que conteste SÍ. En su web oficial, que he buscado yo, aparece empleo@example.com. Me huele raro, pero estoy buscando trabajo de verdad.
reply: Hola: he recibido un WhatsApp desde un número desconocido que dice ser del equipo de Recursos Humanos de Hogar Sur y me ofrece un trabajo desde casa por 350 euros al día. ¿Podéis confirmarme si es un mensaje vuestro? No he contestado ni he pulsado ningún enlace. Gracias, Lucía Romero
note: No se contesta al número: este correo va a la dirección de empleo que aparece en la web oficial, escrita a mano. Si confirman que es falso, bloquear y denunciar el número en WhatsApp.

situation: Just got a text from a number I don't know, 415 555 0192: 'Hi it's Dana, stuck in a board meeting, need you to buy five $100 gift cards for a client and text me photos of the codes, I'll pay you back today.' Dana is my manager and I only started two weeks ago, and we talk on Slack every day. I don't want to look stupid by checking.
reply: Hi Dana, quick check: I just got a text from 415 555 0192 signed as you, asking me to buy five $100 gift cards and send the codes. I haven't bought anything or replied. I'm guessing that wasn't you? I'll forward it to IT unless you tell me otherwise.
note: Send this on Slack, never to the number. Gift cards, urgency and a new number are the tell; new starters are targeted because they don't want to ask, and asking never looks stupid.

situation: 我在闲鱼上卖一台二手平板电脑，标价2300。有个买家说要走'担保交易'，让我加他微信，再点他发的链接'开通商家保证金'，还说不开通的话货款会被冻结。
reply: 不用了，我只在闲鱼里交易。您直接在平台拍下付款就行。其他链接我不会点。
note: 要你离开平台、点陌生链接、先交'保证金'，三个信号占全了。回一句守住平台规则就停，不争论，然后在闲鱼里举报并拉黑；要确认规则就自己打开闲鱼App查。

situation: I'm moving to Lisbon and found a one-bed on Facebook for €750 a month, well below other listings. The 'landlord', Mark, says he's working in Dubai, can't do viewings, and wants a €1,500 deposit by bank transfer today to hold it, then he'll post the keys. I'll be in Lisbon this weekend.
reply: Thanks, Mark. I'm interested, and I only pay a deposit after I've viewed a flat in person and signed a contract. I'm free to view this Saturday or Sunday; if you're away, an agent or friend showing it is fine.
note: Money, urgency and no viewing is the classic rental scam; if he refuses a viewing, send nothing, stop replying and report the listing to Facebook.

situation: Text from an unknown number: 'Hi Mum, dropped my phone in the sink, this is my new number. Can you pay a £480 bill for me today? My banking app won't work on this phone.' My son Jamie is 23 and his number is still saved in my phone. I want to check with him without replying to the new one.
reply: Jamie, I've just had a text from a new number saying it's you, that you've broken your phone and need me to pay a £480 bill today. I haven't replied or paid anything. Is that really you? Ring me when you see this.
note: Send this to his saved number or call it, never to the new one; until you've spoken to him, pay nothing, then block and report the new number to your carrier's spam service.

situation: For the last hour my phone keeps showing sign-in approval requests for my work account that I didn't start, about ten so far, and I haven't approved any. Now someone called 'IT Helpdesk - Tom' has messaged me on Teams from an outside account telling me to approve the next one so he can 'fix a sync problem'. Our real IT service desk is extension 4400 and servicedesk@example.com.
reply: Hi, in the last hour I've had about ten sign-in approval requests for my work account that I didn't start, and I haven't approved any of them. Someone calling himself 'IT Helpdesk - Tom' then messaged me on Teams from an outside account, asking me to approve the next one to fix a sync problem. I haven't replied to him. Could you check my account? I'm at my desk and can call extension 4400 now if that's quicker.
note: Never approve a prompt you didn't start. Report it to IT through the contact you already have, don't reply to the outside account, and let IT handle reporting and blocking it.

situation: J'ai reçu ce matin un SMS « des impôts » qui m'annonce un remboursement de 312 euros, avec un lien pour saisir ma carte bancaire. Je n'ai pas cliqué. Je veux demander à ma comptable, Hélène Martin, à qui j'écris d'habitude par mail, si un remboursement est vraiment prévu.
reply: Bonjour Hélène, j'ai reçu ce matin un SMS qui se présente comme venant des impôts et m'annonce un remboursement de 312 euros, avec un lien pour saisir ma carte bancaire. Je n'ai pas cliqué et je n'ai rien répondu. Avez-vous connaissance d'un remboursement prévu pour moi ? Merci d'avance et bonne journée.
note: On vérifie auprès d'un contact qu'on avait déjà, jamais via le lien ; signalez le SMS au service anti-spam de votre opérateur, puis supprimez-le.

situation: 我是林小雨的妈妈，她在三年级二班，班主任是王老师。今晚班级家长群里有个和王老师同名同头像的账号发了收款二维码，说每位家长交380元资料费，晚上8点前截止。我手机里存着王老师开学时给的电话。
reply: 王老师您好，我是三年级二班林小雨的妈妈。今晚家长群里有个和您同名同头像的账号发了收款二维码，让每位家长交380元资料费，说晚上8点前截止。我还没有扫码，也没有付钱。想跟您确认一下，这是您发的吗？如果不是，可能需要尽快提醒其他家长先别转账。
note: 用开学时存的电话发短信或直接打给老师，不要私聊群里那个账号，也不要扫码；确认是假冒后在微信里举报该账号，并请群主把它移出群。

situation: 我妈今天上午电脑弹出一个窗口，说电脑中了病毒，让她打上面的“技术支持”电话。她打了，对方让她装了一个远程控制软件，还让她登录网银“检查账户安全”。她刚在微信上跟我说了，我在公司，下午6点下班。
reply: 妈，先别着急，也别怪自己，这种弹窗就是专门设计来骗人的。现在马上做三件事：先把电脑关机或者拔掉网线；对方再打电话来直接挂掉，不管他说什么都别再操作；然后打你银行卡背面的客服电话，告诉他们有陌生人远程登录过你的网银，请他们帮忙查有没有转账、要不要先冻结。我6点下班直接过去，咱们一起把密码都改了。
note: 先止损：只打银行卡背面的号码，不打弹窗里的；如果钱已经被转走，马上报警，并保留通话记录和截图。

situation: Ich heiße Sabine Koch. Gerade hat mich jemand angerufen, angeblich von der Betrugsabteilung meiner Bank, die angezeigte Nummer sah aus wie die echte: Mein Konto sei gehackt, ich solle meine 8.400 Euro Ersparnisse heute auf ein „sicheres Konto“ überweisen. Ich habe aufgelegt, nichts überwiesen und keine Daten genannt, und rufe jetzt selbst die Nummer auf meiner Karte an.
reply: Guten Tag, mein Name ist Sabine Koch, ich bin Kundin bei Ihnen und möchte einen Betrugsversuch melden. Gerade hat mich jemand angerufen, der sich als Ihre Betrugsabteilung ausgegeben hat, und die angezeigte Nummer sah aus wie Ihre. Er sagte, mein Konto sei gehackt und ich solle meine Ersparnisse von 8.400 Euro heute auf ein „sicheres Konto“ überweisen. Ich habe aufgelegt, nichts überwiesen und keine Daten genannt. Können Sie prüfen, ob mit meinem Konto alles in Ordnung ist, und den Vorfall vermerken?
note: Keine echte Bank verlangt eine Überweisung auf ein „sicheres Konto“, und angezeigte Nummern lassen sich fälschen. Nie zurückrufen, nur die Nummer auf der Karte wählen, und den Anruf zusätzlich bei der Polizei anzeigen.

situation: In August I lost $3,200 to a fake crypto trading site and reported it to the police; my case reference is 26-08814 and the officer is Detective Sergeant Ruiz, ds.ruiz@example.com. Today a 'Funds Recovery Bureau' emailed saying they've traced my money and can get it back for a $450 release fee, and they quoted my case number. I haven't replied.
reply: Hello DS Ruiz, I'm writing about case 26-08814. Today I received an email from a 'Funds Recovery Bureau' saying they've traced the $3,200 I lost in August and can return it for a $450 release fee, and it quoted my case number. I haven't replied or paid anything. Is this connected to your investigation in any way, and would you like me to forward the email to you?
note: Anyone asking for a fee to recover lost money is a red flag; check with the officer you already have, send nothing, and report the email as part of your case.

situation: My son Leo, 15, just told me, shaking, that someone he met in a gaming chat got him to send a private photo and is now demanding $500 in gift cards by midnight or they'll send it to his friends and his school. He hasn't paid or replied. He said he's so ashamed he wishes he was dead.
reply: Leo, you did exactly the right thing telling me, and you are not in trouble. The person doing this is a criminal who does it on purpose, and none of this is your fault. We're not paying and we're not answering them: we'll screenshot everything, block them and report it together tonight. You said you wish you were dead, and I'm taking that seriously, so I'm staying right here with you. We'll get through this together.
note: Keep the messages as evidence and report to the platform and the police. He has already said he wishes he was dead: call a crisis line with him tonight, don't leave him alone, and call emergency services if he talks about a plan or you think he is in danger.

situation: 中学からの友達の美咲のLINEアカウントから「写真コンテストに出てるから投票して！」とリンクが届き、続けて「本人確認のためにSMSに届いた6桁のコードを送って」と来た。リンクは押していない。美咲の電話番号は前から登録してある。
reply: 美咲、さっき美咲のLINEから投票のリンクと、SMSに届いた確認コードを送ってほしいというメッセージが来たよ。リンクは開いてないし、コードも送ってない。たぶん美咲じゃないよね？アカウントが乗っ取られているかもしれないから、時間のあるときに電話して。
note: 返信はLINEではなく登録済みの番号へ。コードは誰にも送らない。乗っ取りと確認できたらLINEの通報機能で報告し、美咲から別の手段で友達に注意を呼びかけてもらう。

situation: I run a small bakery, Rye & Crumb, and our real Instagram is @ryeandcrumb. Since yesterday a fake account, @ryeandcrumb.giveaway, using our logo has been DMing our followers saying they've won a hamper and need to pay $9.99 shipping through a link. Two customers have messaged us asking if it's real, and one of them has already paid.
reply: Heads up: an account called @ryeandcrumb.giveaway is messaging our followers about a hamper giveaway and asking for $9.99 shipping through a link. That isn't us. We're not running a giveaway, and we will never ask you to pay or enter card details through a DM. Please don't click the link; report and block the account instead. If you've already paid, call the number on the back of your card today so your bank can stop it. Anything really from us comes from @ryeandcrumb only.
note: Report the fake account to Instagram and don't message it; reply privately to the customer who paid, pointing them to their bank and to the police if money has gone.

situation: 大学室友阿伟（认识八年了）今晚在微信上找我，说他在做“跑分”兼职，想借我的银行卡帮他收几笔“货款”，每收1万给我200块好处费，钱一到账就转走。我觉得不对劲，不想借，也想提醒他。他的手机号我一直存着。
reply: 阿伟，刚才微信上让我借银行卡收货款、每收1万给200的那条，是你本人发的吗？如果是你，卡我不借，也劝你赶紧停下：这种“跑分”常被用来转骗来的钱，借卡、收钱的人很容易被卷进去。如果不是你，那你的微信可能被盗了，赶紧改密码。方便的话给我回个电话。
note: 用手机里存的号码发短信或打电话，不在那个微信对话里回，卡、密码、验证码一律不给；如果是盗号就在微信里举报，如果他已经借出卡或收过钱，劝他尽快联系银行并报警。

situation: My school friend Nina posted a link in our six-person WhatsApp group: 'Free $250 grocery voucher for every household, just enter your card details to claim!' It's really her, she says her sister sent it to her, and two people have already asked if it works. I haven't clicked it.
reply: Thanks for thinking of us, Nina, but I'd hold off on this one: free voucher links that ask for card details are a common scam, and they spread exactly like this, through friends passing them on in good faith. Please don't enter anything. If anyone already has, call the number on the back of your card today.
note: The friend is fooled, not hacked: thank her, blame the pattern, not her, and give the group one action. Report the link in WhatsApp, and anyone who has lost money should call the bank and the police.

situation: My gran, Edna, who's 84, just phoned me: a man calling himself DC Hughes from a police fraud squad told her staff at her bank are stealing from customers, and asked her to withdraw £4,000 in cash tomorrow and hand it to a courier at her door at 2pm 'as evidence', and to tell nobody. She hasn't withdrawn anything. I'm her granddaughter Sophie and I can be at hers by 1pm tomorrow.
reply: Gran, thank you for telling me, you did exactly the right thing. Police don't ask people to take out cash, hand it to a courier or keep it secret, so this man isn't the police. Please don't go to the bank tomorrow, and if he rings again, just put the phone down. I'll be with you by 1pm, and if anyone comes to the door before then, keep it shut and call 999.
note: Report the call to the police and ring her bank's fraud line on the number on her card, from another phone or after a few minutes, since scammers can hold the line open; if any money goes, call the bank and police straight away.

situation: On Wednesday 30 September $300 landed in my account from a name I don't know, Jordan Pell. Today a text from 555-0163 says it was sent to me by mistake and asks me to send it back to a different account 'urgently'. I haven't replied or sent anything, and I want to message my bank through its app.
reply: Hi, on Wednesday 30 September I received a payment of $300 from a name I don't recognise, Jordan Pell. Today I got a text from 555-0163 saying it was sent by mistake and asking me to send it back to a different account urgently. I haven't replied or moved any money. Could you check whether the payment is genuine, and if it was a mistake, return it through the bank rather than me sending it anywhere?
note: Never send 'mistaken' money on to a new account; let the bank reverse it. Report the text to your carrier's spam service and block the number, and if you have already sent money, call the bank and the police straight away.

situation: I applied for a remote data entry job on a job board, and today someone calling herself Karen from Brightloop Staffing messaged me on Telegram saying I'm hired without an interview. She wants photos of my passport and both sides of my bank card by tonight for 'payroll setup'. I haven't sent anything, and the Brightloop website, which I looked up myself, lists careers@example.com.
reply: Hello, I applied for a remote data entry role through a job board, and today someone calling herself Karen from Brightloop Staffing messaged me on Telegram. She said I was hired without an interview and asked for photos of my passport and both sides of my bank card by tonight for payroll setup. I haven't sent anything or replied to her. Could you confirm whether this message came from your team?
note: Never send ID or card photos to anyone you haven't verified; report and block the Telegram account and the job listing, and if any details were already sent, call your bank and report it to the police.

situation: 我是3栋1201的住户。今天下午两个人敲门，说是燃气公司来做安全检查，说我家燃气软管老化必须马上换，要收280元，还不让我先打电话问。我没开门，他们接着去敲隔壁了。物业服务中心的电话我手机里一直存着，想先问物业有没有安排这次检查。
reply: 物业您好，我是3栋1201的住户。今天下午有两个人来敲门，说是燃气公司做安全检查，说我家燃气软管老化必须马上换，要收280元，还不让我先打电话核实。我没有开门，也没有付钱，他们接着去敲邻居家了。请问这周物业或燃气公司有没有安排上门检查？如果没有，麻烦尽快在业主群和单元门口提醒大家别开门、别付钱，也请保安留意一下这两个人。谢谢！
note: 只用手机里存的物业电话核实，不打对方给的号码；他们再来纠缠或想硬闯，别开门，直接打110。已经有邻居付了钱的，提醒他们保留凭证并报警。

situation: I'm Dee, admin of our Millbrook neighbourhood WhatsApp group. After last week's flooding, Rosa Kim, who manages the community centre, posted on Monday that donations are only being collected at the centre's front desk, and I have her number saved. Today a number I don't know, 555-0187, posted a bank account claiming to be 'Rosa's relief team' and asking everyone to transfer money by tonight; I've deleted the post.
reply: Hi all, I've removed a post from 555-0187 asking for flood relief money by bank transfer in Rosa's name. Rosa told us on Monday that donations are only collected at the community centre's front desk, so please don't send anything to that account or reply to that number. If you've already transferred money, call your bank's fraud line straight away. I'm phoning Rosa on her saved number to check, and I'll update here.
note: Remove and report the number in WhatsApp; anyone who paid should contact their bank and report it to the police.

situation: I'm Nadia, a piano teacher. A new student's father, Paul Grady, who I've only dealt with by email, mailed me a cheque for $1,850 for ten lessons at $85 each, then said it was a mistake and asked me to send the $1,000 difference today by bank transfer to his 'assistant'. I deposited it yesterday, my banking app already shows the money as available, I haven't sent anything, and I'm messaging my bank through its app.
reply: Hi, yesterday I deposited a cheque for $1,850 from Paul Grady, the father of a new piano student I've only dealt with by email. It was meant to cover ten lessons at $85, so it's $1,000 too much, and he's now asking me to send the difference today by bank transfer to his assistant. I haven't sent anything. Could you check whether the cheque is genuine and tell me when it has truly cleared, since the app already shows the money as available?
note: 'Available' can appear before a cheque has really cleared: send none of it on, stop replying to Paul and report the emails as fraud; if money has already gone, call the bank and the police straight away.

situation: I lead a six-person marketing team. This morning our copywriter Ines Duarte's work email sent all of us a 'Q4 bonus review' link asking us to sign in to view it. IT has confirmed her account was compromised and asked me to warn the team in our Slack channel; Ines is on a flight until 6pm.
reply: Heads up, team: the 'Q4 bonus review' email from Ines this morning didn't come from her. Her account was compromised, and IT has confirmed it. Please don't open the link or sign in. If you already did, change your password now and tell IT straight away, no blame at all. Ines is on a flight until 6pm, so no need to message her about it.
note: Warn in a channel the team already trusts, make owning up blame-free, and forward the email to IT's phishing report route before deleting it.

situation: My dad Frank, 71, is selling his old lawnmower for $120 on a local marketplace. He's just texted me that a buyer called Kevin wants to 'make sure he's real' before driving over, so Kevin is sending a 6-digit code to Dad's phone and Dad should read it back; Dad says he'll do it in five minutes. The text with the code says not to share it with anyone.
reply: Dad, please don't send Kevin that code. A real buyer never needs a code from you, and the text itself says not to share it with anyone. Don't reply to Kevin at all: just block him and report him on the marketplace. If you've already sent it, ring me straight away and we'll change your passwords together. A genuine buyer will come and look at the mower and pay you in person.
note: Report the account on the marketplace; if a code was shared, secure the accounts at once, and if any money has gone, call the bank and the police.

situation: I'm Priya Shah. Yesterday I posted publicly that Skyvale Air lost my suitcase; my claim reference is LB-7731. Within minutes an account called @SkyvaleCare_Help, using the airline's logo, replied asking me to DM my phone number and card details so they can pay compensation. I haven't replied, and I'm writing to the airline through the chat in its own app.
reply: Hi, I'm Priya Shah, writing about my lost-bag claim LB-7731. After I posted about it publicly yesterday, an account called @SkyvaleCare_Help, using your logo, replied asking me to send my phone number and card details by DM for compensation. I haven't replied or sent anything. Can you confirm that account isn't yours, and tell me how compensation on my claim will actually be paid?
note: Don't reply to the lookalike account; report it to the platform. If card details were already sent, call the bank at once, and the police if money has gone.

situation: Meu irmão Rafael, de 34 anos, colocou R$ 5.000 num aplicativo chamado Lucro Certo que promete 3% de rendimento por dia e quer colocar mais R$ 10.000 na semana que vem; ele também me chamou para entrar. Ontem eu disse que parecia golpe e ele ficou bravo, disse que eu estou com inveja. Ele nunca tentou sacar nada e eu não quero que ele pare de falar comigo.
reply: Rafa, desculpa pelo jeito que eu falei ontem. O dinheiro é seu e a decisão é sua, não vou ficar insistindo, e eu não vou entrar. Só te peço uma coisa antes de colocar os R$ 10.000: tenta sacar os R$ 5.000 que já estão lá. Mesmo que caia, espera uma semana antes de colocar mais, porque esses apps costumam pagar os primeiros saques. Se aparecer taxa, prazo ou desculpa para não liberar, me liga, e eu juro que não vou dizer que eu avisei.
note: Com quem ficou na defensiva, um teste concreto vale mais que discutir, mas um saque que funciona não prova que é seguro: promessa de 3% ao dia é sinal clássico de golpe. Se ele já perdeu dinheiro, ajude a ligar para o banco e registrar boletim de ocorrência.
